subject.title: Bug: Telegram delivery queue recovery can replay old sendMessage replies and duplicate delivery-mirror transcript entries

question: How should OpenClaw handle legacy Telegram pending delivery-queue rows that have ambiguous `sendMessage` network failures but no `recoveryState`?
rationale: Source shows current main protects newly marked rows, but old shipped JSON rows can still migrate as replayable; deciding whether to fail, quarantine, reconcile, or replay those rows is an upgrade and message-delivery policy choice.

options.title: Quarantine Ambiguous Legacy Rows
options.body: Mark or move legacy Telegram rows with ambiguous post-send errors to a failed/quarantine state during migration or recovery so they are not replayed blindly.

options.title: Add Explicit Reconciliation First
options.body: Keep ambiguous rows pending only if Telegram gains a real `reconcileUnknownSend` path that can prove whether the send landed before replay.

options.title: Keep Legacy Replayable
options.body: Leave old rows replayable and accept that some upgrades may duplicate Telegram replies or transcript mirror entries after recovery.

recommendation.title: Quarantine Ambiguous Legacy Rows
recommendation.body: Mark or move legacy Telegram rows with ambiguous post-send errors to a failed/quarantine state during migration or recovery so they are not replayed blindly.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest merged-history connection to the delivery dedupe follow-up cluster among the identified owners.
